system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: arranges the input. The list element order matters here and this applies to all the following list input/output specifications.
system_prompt_style.note: Prompt assembled from configurable sections (instruction, output/action specification files, online task info) per paper Fig. 3.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: If `fullpage==True`, the agent takes the entire page as the input.
env_context_strategy.note: Web environment: the current page observation is injected each step and the agent navigates via click/type/go_back.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: If `prune==True`, the pipeline carries out observation space alignment.
context_compaction.note: The observation is pruned, and the interaction history is limited by step_num=3 and by planning-tree based selective replay (paper Sec. 4.2).

observation_format.evidence_quote: You can use `type: ["text", "image"]` to enable multimodality inputs.
observation_format.note: The default is text accessibility tree converted partly to Markdown; images are opt-in.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: click [id]: To click on an element with its numerical id on the web page.
tool_call_format.note: Action strings parsed from model text output; the closest value was chosen.

tool_count.note: Counts 5 navigation commands and 2 planning commands; go_home and scroll are also shipped.

edit_primitive.note: This is a web agent with no file editing.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: You only need to add the description for that entry under `AgentOccam/prompts/output_specifications`.

protocol_standardization.note: No mcp/a2a files appear in the file tree.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: If you use best-of-**N**-actions with judge, the `number` here defines the **N**.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: We introduce two actions, branch and prune, to generate plans in a tree structure and save them for future observations.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: We achieve this without using in-context examples, new agent roles, online feedback or search strategies.
